**Brown-Forman (Jack Daniel's parent) — latest quarter (Q1 FY2027, ended July 31, 2026):**

- **Net sales: $911 million**, down 1% vs. $924 million a year earlier (also -1% organic)
- Operating income: $252 million, down 3% reported (+4% organic)
- Diluted EPS: $0.38, up 6% YoY
- Notable drivers: end of the Korbel distribution deal, weaker tequila sales (Herradura/el Jimador down 12%), lower used-barrel sales; offset by RTD sales up 20% (New Mix +48%) and 9% organic growth in emerging markets
- U.S. net sales down 3% reported; full-year FY2027 outlook reaffirmed
